diagnostics.message: google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service associates this project as a Shared VPC service project, which requires the Compute API to be enabled in the project first. Unlike its siblings google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project.shared_vpc_host (which depends_on google_project_service.project_services) and service_projects (which inherits that ordering), this resource only depends on the VPC-SC perimeter resources and has no path to google_project_service.project_services. Add it to depends_on (no clean data reference exists since the project id is referenced via local.project.project_id).

google_compute_project_default_network_tier.default_network_tier calls the Compute API (projects.setDefaultNetworkTier) and must run after the Compute API is enabled. Its sibling in main.tf, google_compute_project_metadata_item.default, carries depends_on = [google_project_service.project_services], but default_network_tier has no such ordering (its only reference is var.default_network_tier, and the project comes via local.project.project_id). Add google_project_service.project_services to depends_on.

google_monitoring_monitored_project.primary adds this project to a Cloud Monitoring metrics scope, an operation that requires the Cloud Monitoring API to be enabled in the project. It currently has no dependency of any kind (only var.metric_scopes and local.project.project_id are referenced), unlike its sibling google_compute_project_metadata_item.default which orders after project_services. Add google_project_service.project_services to depends_on so the API is enabled first.
